bias.en: Rebound · MACD up, stalled under the 10-day
bias.zh: 反弹 · MACD 向上，受阻于 10 日均线

read.en: MP Materials fell 3.4% on Nov 10 to $36.46, trading $35.60–37.27. It is above the 5-day ($35.85) and below the 10-day ($37.77), 30-day ($41.08), 100-day ($48.30) and 200-day ($54.13); all five averages are falling. MACD has been above its signal since Nov 9, below zero, histogram widening; Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Nov 3 ($40.42), and RSI is 39.
read.zh: MP Materials 11月10日下跌 3.4%，收于 $36.46，盘中区间 $35.60–37.27。股价位于 5 日（$35.85）均线上方，10 日（$37.77）、30 日（$41.08）、100 日（$48.30）和 200 日（$54.13）均线下方；五条均线均在下行。MACD 自 11月9日起位于信号线上方，在零轴下方，柱状图扩大；抛物线 SAR 自 11月3日起看空（$40.42），RSI 为 39。

read.en: No level changed: the $37.27 high stayed under the $37.8–38.1 resistance, and the $35.60 low held the $35.6–35.9 support (Nov 4 low, 5-day). Resistance is $37.8–38.1 (10-day, Jul 29 low, Nov 9 high), then $39 (Nov 4 high) and $40.4–41.1 (SAR, 30-day). Support is $35.6–35.9, then $33.8 and $31.9 (52-week low). A close above $38.1 would target $39–40.4; below $35.6, $33.8.
